This kinase is identified as a target of multiple entities, including (3E,5R)-3-[2-[(1S,4aS,8aS)-5,5,8a-trimethyl-2-methylidene-3,4,4a,6,7,8-hexahydro-1H-naphthalen-1-yl]ethylidene]-5-hydroxyoxolan-2-one and CID 21778290. All these entities are linked to MIP through a series of target relationships, indicating a possible pathway by which Corticatic Acid E may influence MIP. The scores from the paths are consistent, suggesting a reliable association, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a plausible biological interaction, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct relationship between Corticatic Acid E and MIP.
